description: This file defines an enum called PasswordStrength, representing different levels of password strength with associated string labels and numeric values. It includes methods to convert from numeric value to enum and to get string representations.

classes.name: PasswordStrength
classes.description: An enum representing password strength levels with associated labels and numeric values, including methods for conversion and string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string label of the password strength.

methods.name: getStrengthNum
methods.description: Returns the numeric value associated with the password strength.

methods.name: fromValue
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding PasswordStrength enum, throwing an exception if out of range.
